spans.s: मघ् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. मंघते) 1. To deceive, to cheat; 2. to gamble; 3. to go, to move; 4. to begin; 5. to blame, to censure.
मघ् (II) vt. 1P (pres. मंघति) To adorn, to decorate.
मघ (I) m. 1. Name of one of the divisions of the universe; 2. name of a country; 3. pleasure; 4. a kind of medicine.
मघ (II) n. A kind of flower.
मघा f. Name of the tenth lunar mansion consisting of five stars.

माघ m. 1. Name of a lunar month; 2. name of the author of the Śiśupālavadha; he was son of Dattaka, श्रीशब्दरम्यकृतसर्गसमाप्तिलक्ष्म लक्ष्मीपतेश्चरितकीर्तनचारु माघः … … काव्यं व्यधत्त शिशुपालवधाभिधानम् Sis.xx.84.
मघ-व, -वत् m. an epithet of Indra.
मघ-व, -वत् m. an epithet of Indra.
मघ-वन् m. (nom. sing. मघवा; acc. pl. मघोन) 1. an epithet of Indra, दुदोह गां स यज्ञाय सस्याय मघवा दिवम् R.i.26, iii.46, K.S.iii.1, Megh.i.6; 2. an owl; 3. an epithet of Vyāsa.
मघा-त्रयोदशी f. the thirteenth day of the second half of Bhādrapada.
मघा-भव, -भू m. the planet Venus.
मघा-भव, -भू m. the planet Venus.
मघोनी f. An epithet of Śachī, wife of Indra.
माघमा f. A female crab.
माघवत a. (f. ती) Belonging to Indra.
माघवत a. (f. ती) Belonging to Indra.
माघवती f. the east.
माघवत-चाप m. the rainbow.
माघवन a. (f. नी) Belonging to or ruled by Indra, ककुभं समस्कुरुत माघवनीम् Sis.ix.15, न वनी माघवनी विलासहेतुः Jag.
माघवन a. (f. नी) Belonging to or ruled by Indra, ककुभं समस्कुरुत माघवनीम् Sis.ix.15, न वनी माघवनी विलासहेतुः Jag.
माघी f. The day of full-moon in the month of Māgha.
माघ्य m. The flower of the kunda creeper.
